tasks.short: Prepare and implement remedial programs for learners needing extra help.

steps.what: Assess the learner through their actual work and a discussion of difficulties
Assemble a remedial program draft from approved exercises and teacher-entered needs
inputs: approved exercise catalogue and difficulty labels

steps.what: Choose adaptations and approve the complete final remedial program for the learner
outputs: approved final remedial program and learner destination

steps.what: Save the approved final remedial program to the learner record
inputs: approved final remedial program and learner destination

steps.what: Implement remedial activities and adapt instruction to the learners actual response
outputs: actual remedial activity and observed learner response

steps.what: Write and approve the actual activity, learner response and next instructional adjustment
inputs: actual remedial activity and observed learner response
outputs: approved final remedial session note and learner identity

steps.what: Commit the approved final remedial session note
inputs: approved final remedial session note and learner identity

tasks.design: Use the {LMS} native exercise library and program template to reduce assembly only. The teacher assesses, selects adaptations, teaches and records actual outcomes. Program and later session record have separate final approvals and saves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exercises and learner observations may need repeated manual assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse approved exercise records without deciding a learners needs.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the difficulty and adapting live instruction.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher sees confusion, motivation and progress in context.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course templates and exercise libraries can reduce repeat assembly.

assumptions: All shares and savings are provisional; existing native assembly and save actions earn no new benefit. Observe remaining manual work first.

Teacher produces learner_id, observed_difficulty, selected_exercise_ids and planned_adaptation in s1-s3; selecting and checking are retained. Teacher-maintained catalogue already exists, with incremental upkeep counted below. Missing suitable exercises require manual development with no assembly saving.
s6 captures actual session_date, completed_activity, observed_response and next_adjustment after teaching at full time. Saved plans do not stand for completed sessions.
research_questions: Which remedial exercises are repeatedly assembled after current LMS features?

incremental.description: Maintain exercise difficulty labels and program template

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final remedial program and learner
s6 actual final session note and learner

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 assembly plus 5 program-save plus 2 note-save hours less 1 upkeep = 12. Low halves only assembly benefit: 3 minus 1 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe and evaluate other instructors performance.

steps.what: Observe another instructor teaching and collect specific evidence of their performance
Write specific observation evidence and evaluate the instructors performance against criteria
Assemble the evaluation document using the native observation template and entered evidence
Check fairness, evidence, instructor identity and approve the final evaluation record
outputs: approved final instructor evaluation and restricted record destination

steps.what: Save the approved final evaluation in the restricted instructor record
inputs: approved final instructor evaluation and restricted record destination

tasks.design: Configure an observation document template in {DOCS}; keep observation, evidence writing and evaluative judgement with the teacher. No model scores another instructor. The complete final evaluation is approved before its separate restricted save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evaluation document assembly may repeat headings and evidence formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates provide a simpler route than a scoring model.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting teaching quality fairly from limited observation.
tasks.human_edge: A teacher understands context and can distinguish a missed opportunity from poor practice.
tasks.altitude: Human evaluation supported by a reusable observation form.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can reuse evaluation headings and evidence fields without assigning ratings.

assumptions: Provisional shares must be checked against actual observations and current templates; existing template use earns no saving.

s2 retains full capture of instructor_id, observation_date, concrete_examples, criterion and teacher_evaluation. s3 reuses these teacher-authored fields, not inferred behaviour. Missing evidence is investigated manually.
The 5 retained s3 hours include checking layout and completeness. s4 retains final fairness and factual review. No staff notification is silently included.
unknowns: Whether any manual document assembly remains
Actual evaluation criteria and access restrictions
research_questions: Does a native observation template remove existing manual formatting while preserving evidence quality?

incremental.description: Maintain the agreed observation form and restricted destination

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final evaluation and restricted destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 5 assembly and 2 save hours minus 1 upkeep = 6. Low halves assembly only: 2.5 minus 1 = 1.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize and supervise developmental games and recreational activities.

steps.what: Select and organize games around participants needs, space, equipment and developmental aims
inputs: actual participant needs and access requirements

steps.what: Set up, explain and supervise games while adapting to participants actual behaviour
Write actual attendance, activity outcomes and relevant physical, mental or social observations
Check and approve the final activity record and participant identities
outputs: approved final activity record and destination

steps.what: Commit the approved final activity record
inputs: approved final activity record and destination

tasks.design: Reuse approved game plans in {DOCS}, with current venue details checked in {CALENDAR}. The teacher chooses appropriate games and supervises them. Actual participation and developmental observations are written afterwards, checked and separately committed to {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated activity setup can require rewriting an existing game plan.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse instructions and equipment lists.
tasks.still_hard: Supervision, inclusion and responding to physical or social difficulties.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher notices participation and changes the activity in the moment.
tasks.altitude: Reusable plans beside live recreational supervision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document templates reuse approved game instructions and equipment lists.

assumptions: Provisional allocation assumes some repeated manual plan assembly after current templates; verify that work before claiming benefit.

Teacher checks group_size, access_needs, venue, available_equipment and chosen_game in s1; the retained 14 hours cover selection, actual checks and adaptation. Template instructions come from the existing approved game library; absent appropriate plans uses manual planning.
s3 retains full capture of actual attendance, completed_activity and observed_response after supervision. Native attendance features already running receive no new saving.
research_questions: Which recurring games still require manually repeated plan preparation?

incremental.description: Keep game instructions and equipment lists current

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete actual activity record and destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 plan assembly and 1 record-save hours minus 1 upkeep = 6. Low halves only assembly benefit: 3 minus 1 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in publicity planning and recruit students.

steps.what: Plan publicity with colleagues using actual course capacity, audience needs and recruitment experience
inputs: actual course dates, fees and capacity
outputs: agreed publicity aims and checked course facts

steps.what: Assemble publicity material from checked course facts and approved course descriptions
inputs: agreed publicity aims and checked course facts
approved course description and publicity template

steps.what: Approve the complete final recruitment notice, audience, channel and course details
inputs: agreed publicity aims and checked course facts
outputs: approved final notice and exact recipient list

steps.what: Send the approved final recruitment notice to the approved external audience
inputs: approved final notice and exact recipient list

steps.what: Discuss course suitability with prospective students and answer their actual questions
outputs: actual recruitment conversation and expressed interest

steps.what: Write and approve actual contact notes, permitted follow-up and recruitment outcomes
inputs: actual recruitment conversation and expressed interest
outputs: approved final actual recruitment contact note

steps.what: Save the approved final recruitment contact note
inputs: approved final actual recruitment contact note

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} publicity template and {EMAIL} approved send action. Keep planning and actual recruitment conversations with the teacher. Capture and approve actual outcomes afterwards in {CRM}; its existing direct save earns no new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Publicity material can repeat course facts already held in an approved description.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and reviewed recipient lists reduce assembly and sending work.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining course fit and earning interest through conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher understands expectations and can explain the class honestly.
tasks.altitude: Teacher-led recruitment with factual publicity assembly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates and native email sends can reuse approved course facts and recipient lists.

assumptions: All allocations are provisional; verify residual publicity assembly and send effort after current tools. Existing send automation earns no new saving.

Teacher checks course_id, dates, location, fee, capacity and actual audience permission in s1-s3. Course administrator supplies existing current course facts and authorised recipient list; no new uncounted list creation is assumed. Missing facts or uncertain permission returns preparation to manual work.

s6 captures actual name, course_interest, question, permitted_follow_up and outcome at full time after conversation. s7 is the existing manual direct save and is gated despite having no saving. No enrolment or follow-up send is silently performed.
research_questions: Which course facts are repeatedly copied into notices after current native templates?

incremental.description: Maintain course template and checked distribution mapping

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final notice and exact audience
s6 actual final contact note and identified contact

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 assembly and 5 send hours less 1 upkeep = 10. Low halves assembly only: 3 minus 1 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Personal instruction with reusable plans and explicit records.
reach: Consistent planning without replacing live teaching
skills_to_grow: Maintaining reusable exercise and activity libraries
Checking final publicity and learner records
role.ambitious_version: Teachers reuse sound materials while retaining assessment, observation, live adaptation and recruitment conversations.
